॥ Om, and the description of form, is Om. ॥ 1/2/23 ॥

“[It is said:] ‘When the Seer beholds the golden-hued Creator, the Lord, the Cosmic Person, the womb of Brahman…’”

“[It is also said:] ‘In the beginning, there was only Narayana; there was neither Brahma nor Shanka (Shiva). That sage, having meditated, from Him arose the worlds, Hiranyagarbha, Agni, Yama, Varuna, Rudra, and Indra. That Supreme Narayana has four forms: white, red, golden, and black. He assumed these forms from these [elements], and He mixed them together. Thus, this form is of such a nature.’”

Thus, the forms of that very [Narayana] are described. ॥ 23 ॥
